archetype: Organic & Earthy + High Contrast (Hybrid: Trust & Premium Fintech)
design_philosophy: Modern travel + fintech hybrid. Apple Wallet meets Airbnb. Premium, friendly, and highly accessible. White backgrounds, soft ambient shadows, deeply rounded corners (iOS style), with vivid ocean blue to teal gradients strictly reserved for primary actions, Premium highlights, and active states.
tech_instructions_for_main_agent: You are building a mobile-first PWA. All primary layout must be wrapped in `<div className='max-w-[430px] mx-auto min-h-screen bg-white relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col shadow-2xl'>`.
Do NOT build a desktop layout. Hide desktop scrollbars. The container should represent a flagship smartphone screen (iPhone 15 Pro Max dimensions).
For the bottom navigation, use a fixed/absolute div at the bottom of the main mobile container, NOT the screen.
Use Framer Motion for slide-up bottom sheets, page transitions, and micro-interactions.

Implement the 13 flows specifically mentioned in the MVP scope: Auth, Home, Trips list, Trip Creation, Trip Dashboard, Add Expense, Borrow/Lending Ledger, AI TripBuddy chat, SOS, Vendor Marketplace, Wallet, Profile, Premium Subscription.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
NEVER use external placeholders. Use ONLY the images provided in the media section below.

components.bottom_nav: Absolute bottom-0 w-full backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-t border-slate-200/50 pb-safe pt-2 px-6 flex justify-between items-center z-50
components.primary_button: w-full py-4 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-600 to-teal-400 text-white font-semibold text-lg shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(0,122,255,0.25)] hover:shadow-[0_12px_24px_rgba(0,122,255,0.35)] active:scale-[0.98] transition-all
components.secondary_button: w-full py-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 font-semibold text-lg active:bg-slate-200 transition-all
components.card: bg-white p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-100 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]
components.glass_sheet: absolute bottom-0 w-full bg-white rounded-t-[32px] p-6 shadow-[0_-8px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] z-40
components.sos_button: w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-red-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,59,48,0.5)] animate-pulse border-4 border-white
components.ai_typing_indicator: flex space-x-1 items-center bg-slate-100 rounded-2xl py-3 px-4 w-fit
components.avatar: w-10 h-10 rounded-full border-2 border-white shadow-sm overflow-hidden

onboarding.usage: Use for the onboarding carousel highlighting community, travel together, and expense splitting.

vendors.usage: Use for the Airbnb-like vendor marketplace property cards (accommodation visuals).

destinations.usage: Use as background covers for active/past Trip cards in the Home and Trips list views.

animations.page_transition: Framer Motion: `<motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut' }}>`
animations.bottom_sheet: Framer Motion: `<motion.div initial={{ y: '100%' }} animate={{ y: 0 }} exit={{ y: '100%' }} transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 25, stiffness: 200 }}>`
